nom: ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum

avis.texte: Used this serum once and it made my face red and made me break out. Never used it again. Didn't like this product.

avis.titre: Life changing serum for my dry acne prone skin
avis.texte: I've been really struggling with dry skin and acne since moving to the desert from a humid climate. I didn't know what to do with my skin because I kept getting dark spots and I'm a woman of color. This serum has definitely changed my skin. I've noticed my dark spot feeding and I even did one round of micro needling to help jumpstart the results and I always get compliments on my skin now about how I have such a glow. I will continue to purchase this serum for as long as it works for me!
Ive repurchased this serum 4 times now. I love it! It gives me the glass skin look.
Very nice serum. It's is a little thick so I use it at night. I'm not sure that it would work well under makeup but I haven't actually tried it. I am liking it so far!

avis.titre: I really like this product overall
avis.texte: I have acne prone skin and surprisingly this didn't break me out at all which is rare. Good extra layer if you need the extra hydration. The only downside that I haven't seen is the bottle. Mine leaks like crazy and it's really frustrating because it feels like a lot is being wasted. I'm not sure if this is a me problem

This product was recommended to me by my cousin. We both have different skin types. I have oily skin and deal with acne. This serum is extremely light weight and helped reduce my redness from my skin. I would highly recommend to others!
So I had bought this and after three days of using i've seen a lot of results! Surprisingly my skin is very hydrated and plump. Extremely satisfying!
I am enjoying this serum very much. It does a great job at plumping and hydrating my skin.

This helped the texture and tone of my skin. I had tiny little bumps close to my eyebrows on my forehead that I've been trying to get rid of for months not sure what caused it. It was not acne, but just tiny little bumps. My skin is a lot smoother and brighter.
love this serum! it has made a huge difference in my skin so far when it comes to soothing & repairing! especially during the massachusetts winter

avis.titre: Unfortunately my skin is not love
avis.texte: I think the ingredients seem like it would help but unfortunately my skin did not care for these. My skin felt more dry while using and then it cause skin to dermatitis. I had to return discard it after two weeks or use. Some of their other products are great though.
I highly recommend this for someone that needs a good skin barrier, and have acne!! this made my skin look like glass if combined with good products!

This is the best hydrating serum I've ever used, even when compared to expensive luxury products. It absorbs well, but also leaves a protective barrier that strengthens skin. I love that it contains ceramides and arbutin - those are two of my favorite ingredients! The arbutin imparts a glow and the ceramides act as skin building blocks, making the product more hydrating. It floods mt skin with pasting moisture, even in the dry atmosphere of Colorado. The texture is beautiful - its kind of similar to snail mucin. This stuff leavesy skin so healthy and beautiful - its a must have!

This stuff is the best! I use it directly after my face wash (skin1004 ampoule foam) and before my moisturizer (La Roche Posay matte moisturizer or Dr. Althea 345 cream depending on the weather or Paula's Choice Daily Moisturizer SPF 50). Everthing listed works well together on my really oily skin. I dont even have excess oil anymore. These product combos work well under makeup too! I started using this after I had irritation from a chemical exfoliant. I swear I could see my skin getting healthier again after only 3-4 uses. I previously had trouble with redness and dryness on my cheeks, but now I don't! My makeup just glides on now.

Earlier this year, I had to start using benzoyl peroxide to get my acne under control, which made my oily skin red, irritated, and flaky. I needed something super hydrating and soothing to counteract it, landed on this serum, and I'm so glad I did. It's thick but not sticky, super hydrating, and calmed my skin right down. I'm using it 2x daily along with a peptide serum, very happy with the results. This has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine.

I came in to ulta about a week or so ago to pick up an order for my sister and decided to walk around not really expecting to buy anything. This caught my eye as it has hyaluronic acid and was much cheaper than what I usually use which is the Loreal Hyaluronic Acid. After only a week of use I've noticed my skin is much smoother and brighter. I'm honestly surprised and wish I switched to this sooner as it is a cheaper alternative to loreal which I've been using for around 2-3 year. It works just as well if not better than loreals hyaluronic acid and I 100% recommend it.

avis.titre: Yes I going to buy it again and again
avis.texte: Omg it's the best serum I ever use in a long time ,I love it so much

avis.titre: amazing product - doesn't make me breakout!!
avis.texte: I tend to have a hard time adding new products into my skincare routine because EVERYTHING makes me breakout. The last year or so my skin has gotten very very dry. After reading many reviews I decided to try this product out and I am AMAZED !!!

avis.titre: Best Barrier Serum for Skin of Color
avis.texte: I have darker, oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin, and this is the best barrier serum I've ever used. Like, it does all the things I like and need: repairs skin barrier with the ceramides, helps with hyperpigmentation and acne scars with the alpha arbutin, evens skin tone with the niacinamide, moisturizes without being thick or occlusive with the glycerin and beta-glucan and rice water derivatives. This is by far my favorite ceramide serum. I've used the Cocokind barrier serum too, and it was the same cost for a little over half the amount of product as the Anua serum. And the Anua serum lasts three times as long as the Cocokind serum does, since the slimy texture makes just one pump cover more area. My bottle of the Anua serum lasted me about 3 months, and my skin DRASTICALLY improved over that time. My acne scars were much less visible, my skin was smooth and more even toned. My only complaint is that the Anua serum really stings if applied over broken or open skin, maybe because of the alpha arbutin or niacinamide, so be aware of that when trying it for the first time. Otherwise, I really love it!!! It does everything I want and feels like a snail mucin serum without the animal cruelty or fungal acne issues. Do try it out!!!

Not only have the oil cleanser completely ruined my skin after judt 2 uses (i never broke out b4 btw) i tried this hoping it would calm the burning and itchiness from thr break out the cleanser caused but no this made it worse unfortunately i broke out even more this time it looks like hives

This is my very first time ever using any kind of serum , and I was very impressed with ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum. My skin is prone to being sensitive, but this face serum did not irritate my skin whatsoever! It instantly left my skin feeling healthier, softer, and much more hydrated. When applying, you'll quickly realize this serum is somewhat thicker, so you do not have to use very much because a little goes a long way with this serum! Your skin may feel somewhat on the stickier side right after rubbing it in to your skin, but the serum quickly drys so you won't feel the "sticky" feeling for more than just a few seconds.
SO FREAKING GOOD. My skin feels sooooo soft, hydrated, plump. It looks dewy. I am so freaking obsessed
This makes my skin feel soft and supple all n the dryness of winter. I use it in the am and pm. This will definitely be a staple in my skincare routine!

The Hydrating Serum was light and absorbed quickly into my skin. It left my face feeling soft and hydrated without any stickiness. After a few days, I noticed my skin looked a bit more refreshed and healthy. It also worked well under my makeup, which was a bonus. It's a simple product, but it gets the job done, and I liked that about it.

avis.titre: ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum
avis.texte: My name is Gabby and I'm a licensed Cosmetologist. I received the 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum. After using the rice enzyme cleansing powder, I applied the barrier serum and let completely dry. I noticed that my hyperpigmentation is brighter. I like that it has the rice and ceramides. It's not sticky and works well with other skincare products. I like that it's something that I can use everyday in my routine because it's light and doesn't irritate the skin. You don't have to use a lot of the serum. I like that Anua products aren't overly priced but give you the results you want. If you want to gradually get the results of glass skin this would be a product to try. Overall, I'd recommend this product and would give five out of five stars.

I love the consistency of this serum. I love how it makes my skin feel nourished and hydrated, but not greasy and like it's clogging my pores. I've accidentally used this with no moisturizer afterwards (rushing, new mom) and this serum alone left me feeling adequately moisturized.

This rice ceramide serum has been a game changer in my skincare routine. I've been experiencing dry skin from the cold weather and my skin has some dry patches. After adding this serum to my morning and night routine, my skin feels much more hydrated and supple. I use this before moisturizer and spf. The consistency is thicker but not sticky and it doesn't have a scent. It didn't irritate my skin at all. It applies well under moisturizer and makeup and gives you a hydrated and glowing feel. Overall, my skin has felt improvement from using this consistently for weeks. I only have to use the serum in the mornings now.

The product packaging was practical and cute, with a glass bottle and light pink pump. It took about 5 to 6 pumps to get the product to come out initially, but after that, the product came out the way it was intended to. The texture of the product was slimey and slippery and felt identiacal to snail mucin, or the mixsoon bean essence formulation, except this product is made of rice, which is a great option for persons that don't want to use the snail extract or bean essence. If you've never used either of those, then the texture of aloe or okra is similar. The product does however slip easily off the hands if youre not careful. The price point is also lower than the bean essence. The product when applied feels very slimey but it quickly absorbed into the skin after about 30 seconds. It absorbed similarly to a water based moisturizer and felt hydrating. For the price point, I would consider switching from the bean essence to this product. Would recommend.

avis.titre: A must have in your skincare routine
avis.texte: I was super excited to try this product because I'm a huge fan of Anua! This serum has a lightweight and watery texture. It's not sticky or greasy, but instead very hydrating. It pairs perfectly with their new cleanser and leaves my skin complexion looking brighter and feeling smoother.

This serum is an absolute powerhouse for hydration and barrier repair. The lightweight yet nourishing texture absorbs beautifully into the skin without feeling heavy or sticky. After consistent use, I noticed my skin feeling softer, more supple, and visibly healthier. The blend of rice extracts and ceramides works wonders in restoring my skin's moisture barrier, especially during colder months when dryness and irritation can be a challenge. It's soothing and calming, making it perfect for sensitive or dehydrated skin.

The Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum is an outstanding product for those looking to boost their skin's hydration and strengthen its protective barrier. This serum features a unique blend of seven types of rice extracts, which are rich in antioxidants and nutrients that help nourish and brighten the skin. The addition of ceramides enhances the serum's ability to repair the skin's moisture barrier, preventing moisture loss and keeping the skin soft and plump throughout the day. The texture is lightweight yet deeply hydrating, absorbing quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. It provides a smooth, supple finish, making it ideal for layering with other products. After consistent use, I noticed a significant improvement in skin texture—my complexion appeared more even, and my skin felt noticeably more hydrated and resilient. It's particularly great for dry or sensitive skin, offering soothing properties while keeping irritation at bay. The serum has a subtle, refreshing scent that adds to the overall pleasant experience. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enhance their skincare routine with a nourishing, barrier-repairing product.

This serum is one of the two products I've tried by Anua recently. I've also tried thrir rice enzyme cleansing powder. I have dry to normal skin type with a hormone imbalance for some background information. This serum has a texture that's similar to snail muscin and bean essence serums. It does not remain sticky though. I find that this serum isn't as hydrating as I hoped it would be. It doesn't take much to use though for the immediate hydrating effect, it just doesn't last for me sadly. I've also noticed some extra breakouts lately too and I can only conclude that they are from using this serum. I say give it a shot though because everyone's skin biome is different so it may work for you unlike it did for me. You never know until you try.

I've been testing this for the past few weeks and I love the results I have already seen. Rice is one of my favorite skincare ingredients, and Anua is a brand that I trust because of its overall ingredients and effectiveness. With this serum I love the many benefits it provides, and it has skin-loving ingredients like hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, and niacinamide to brighten and hydrate. They are free of parabens and sulfates, making them suitable for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: My skin is super glowy add radiant!
avis.texte: The 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum has been a game-changer for my skincare routine! The lightweight yet deeply hydrating formula absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling plump, smooth, and nourished. The combination of rice extract and ceramides strengthens my skin barrier, reducing dryness and irritation while locking in moisture all day. I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's texture and overall radiance since I started using it. It layers beautifully under makeup without feeling greasy or heavy. The subtle, natural scent is a bonus! This serum is perfect for anyone with sensitive or dehydrated skin. I highly recommend it for a healthy, hydrated glow!

I have been using the 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum for the last couple of days and it has become an essential part of my skincare routine. From the very first use, I noticed how lightweight and silky the formula feels—absorbing quickly without any stickiness. It sinks into my skin really well, leaving it soft, plump, and deeply hydrated. I've struggled with extreme dryness this winter, but this serum has been a lifesaver. It has visibly strengthened my skin's barrier, reducing redness and protecting against irritation. I've noticed my complexion looks a lot more healthier and smoother. after using this serum. I also love how it layers really well under other products and works well with makeup. If you're looking for a reliable serum to hydrate and restore your skin, this is it. Highly recommend!

The 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum is a game-changer for my skincare routine! This lightweight serum absorbs quickly, delivering intense hydration without any greasy residue. Infused with rice ceramides, it strengthens the skin's barrier, leaving my complexion plump and radiant. I love how it soothes dryness and enhances my skin's texture, making it feel incredibly soft and smooth. The elegant formula is perfect for layering under moisturizer or sunscreen, and I've noticed a significant reduction in redness and irritation. With consistent use, my skin looks healthier and more balanced. Additionally, it has a subtle, refreshing scent that makes application enjoyable. A must-have for hydration enthusiasts! Highly recommend! This serum has truly become a staple in my daily regimen, and I can't recommend it enough for anyone looking to enhance their skin's hydration and overall appearance.
I bought this serum elsewhere and love how it makes my skin glow and feel. So glad i can get it at Ulta now!!!
Anua Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum💧 This serum left my skin wonderfully hydrated and noticeably brighter. Soothing during application, it's a skincare dream come true.

I am in love with this product! If you have ever tried Cosrx Snail Mucin essence this is right up your alley. Besides being smaller and perfect for travel, the texture is almost the same; except the consistency isn't as slimy and it feels even more hydrating. It absorbs faster and doesn't leave any sticky residue. This is the perfect glass of water to quench winter skin. This serum doesn't leave behind a scent and you can immediately see the difference in skin after each use. It layers my moisturizer and sunscreen perfectly. In just three pumps daily after a week, I have noticed my skin has boosted in hydration without that dreaded tight feeling. Instead it literally bounces back, my skin looks more youthful and even. Plus if you are a makeup wearer like myself, it is the perfect primer! You do need sunscreen anyways but even more so with this product so try tinted moisturizers and don't anticipate any greasy feelings because this product dries down instantly. It pairs perfectly with the Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder. It reinforces protection to your moisture barrier after exfoliating with the previous product. If you are like me trying to fade hyperpigmentation and ingredients like Vitamin C causes heavy irritation, this is a product for you. My only con is that I wish the bottle was bigger lol. Start the year off fresh with this 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum!
This serum is lightweight but super nourishing! It soaks into the skin nicely without leaving a weird texture. I have definitely noticed my skin feeling more plump and hydrated.

It's winter here in NYC and I need extra help keeping my skin feeling hydrated and bright. Anua to the rescue with their Hydrating Barrier Serum. This stuff is heaven-sent! Serums have always been my favorite step in my skin-care routine and using this one is by far my favorite. What makes it so unique is the texture of the serum. It is so slippery and soft. the way it sticks to anything it touches. I have yet to experience anything like it. It's also a powerhouse in terms of the ingredients. Niacinamide, Zinc, Honey extract, and hyaluronic acid. You can't go wrong with this serum! I use just one or two pumps and that is plenty for my skin. Sometimes I forget that I need moisturizer after using this serum. That's how soft my skin feels after using it.

As someone who has always been on the lookout for effective skincare products, I can confidently say that the 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum has become a staple in my routine. Here's why I enjoy using it and how it has transformed my skin. One of the standout features of this serum is its incredible hydrating properties. The formula is rich in ceramides, which are essential for maintaining the skin's natural barrier. Since incorporating this serum into my daily regimen, I've noticed significant improvements in my skin's hydration levels. My face feels plump and nourished, even during the colder months when dryness is a common issue. It absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue, making it perfect for both morning and night use.

avis.titre: Not bad but not the best
avis.texte: I've been using the Anua Ceramide 7 Serum for a few days now, and while I think it's a decent product, it has its drawbacks. The serum has a nice, nourishing formula that's rich in ceramides, which helps to hydrate and repair my skin. However, the texture is a bit sticky, which can be uncomfortable when layering with other products or in warmer weather. Despite the stickiness, I've noticed smoother, more moisturized skin after consistent use. It's a good option for those with dry or sensitive skin, but the stickiness might be a dealbreaker for some. I'd rate it 3/5 – it's effective, just a little inconvenient. I do notice my skin is brighter but also I've notice small white heads appearing. I don't think I will continue to use this product for that reason as well.

As a skincare enthusiast who uses mostly Korean beauty brands, this product is exactly up my alley. Having tried many ANUA products already, this serum has been on my must try list. This barrier serum contains 7 different ceramides that are so good for your skin. I usually apply this right after my toner and before my moisturizer and spf and let me tell you, it is so hydrating! My skin loves this product and no reactions to it although my skin is very sensitive. It makes your skin super glowy and plump - it almost feels as if it's between an essence and serum consistency. It doesn't feel too thick and absorbs right into the skin. As someone who's consistently rotating skincare products, I find myself reaching for this often even though it is a new product for me. It's also compact and travel friendly - major plus because you can take it on your flights without a problem!

The 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum has been a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. This lightweight yet deeply nourishing serum absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it feeling hydrated, plump, and soft without any greasy residue. The unique blend of seven types of rice-derived ingredients, including ceramides, helps strengthen the skin's barrier while locking in moisture. I love how this serum provides long-lasting hydration, especially in the colder months when my skin tends to get dry and flaky. It also calms my skin, making it feel more balanced and less prone to irritation. After using it consistently, I have noticed my complexion looks smoother, more radiant, and overall more resilient. What's also great is that it is suitable for all skin types, even sensitive skin, and works well alongside other skincare products. The 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum is an excellent choice for anyone seeking hydration and skin barrier protection.

I'm absolutely loving the ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum! As someone with combination skin, I'm always on the lookout for products that will provide long-lasting hydration without clogging my pores. This serum has truly exceeded my expectations. The lightweight, watery texture absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving no residue or greasiness behind. I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's overall hydration levels and elasticity since incorporating this serum into my routine. The star ingredient, ceramide, helps repair and strengthen the skin's barrier function, while the rice extract provides an extra boost of hydration and brightening benefits. I've also noticed a reduction in fine lines and wrinkles, giving my skin a smoother and more radiant appearance.

I have been using this serum for just a little over a week now and I have been enjoying it. I have dry skin that gets flaky especially in the winter and using this serum has helped my skin because now it feels really hydrated. I love the consistency and how "stretchy" the serum feels, in a slime like fashion, it is always a fun experience and something I look forward to using at the end of each night. It does not have a smell or a scent really which is how I prefer my skincare. The packaging is also good in that the dispenser pumps out a good amount and it does not get messy by leaking or anything. I will have to use it longer to see if will have any noticeable longterm effects for my skin but just for short term right now I would say I am a fan and I would recommend.

This is an amazing product. I love the texture. I feel like it is an excellent dupe for the snail mucin serum. It is ultra hydrating. Very lightweight, it absorbs super quickly. It has no fragrance. Anua products are literally gold. I love their rice based line. I would 100% recommend.

The consistency of the serum is lightweight and not sticky. The pump does not get stuck either like some pump containers do. I recommend you to try to use it when you have damp skin so that it absorbs correctly into the skin otherwise you end up using more than is needed and your skin ends up drier than it would damp. This gives my skin the glow and hydration the serum is intended to bring to the skin. I use this in the daytime and nighttime for the best results. I like that the container is see through so you the amount is visible and you can stock up before you run out. I like to mix this with my makeup for a natural finish. It works well under makeup and does not cause any peeling. If you use this along with the other products in the lineup then you will get faster and better results. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

As a busy mom and runner, my skincare routine needs to be quick, effective, and deliver results. My daily runs expose my skin to the sun, dirt, and other elements, which leave it looking dull and aged. Add to that the fact that I'm rapidly approaching middle age, and I've become much more mindful about finding products that work. This serum has quickly become one of my favorites. One pump is all it takes to cover my entire face. The texture is smooth, lightweight, and non-sticky, absorbing easily into my skin. The improvement is instant… my skin looks brighter, more hydrated, and just better. I particularly love using it before important events or even a casual night out, as it leaves my skin radiant and refreshed. It also works great with foundation, helping it apply smoothly and preventing any pilling. On some days, I even incorporate it into what I call my "power hour." After returning from my run, I apply the serum while my pores are still open from the heat and sweat, then go about my chores or work for 45 minutes to an hour before hopping in the shower. By the time I'm done, my skin feels hydrated, fresh, and rejuvenated. I didn't think "glass skin" was achievable for me, but this serum has proven me wrong. I recommend trying this serum to anyone looking for a product that can brighten and hydrate quickly and easily.

avis.titre: This is the new go to
avis.texte: I am really enjoying this barrier serum. It is really good and hydrating. It feels great on the skin. I have tried adding moisturizer after and also just skipping moisturizer and my makeup applied just as well. My skin remains hydrated and it feels like it's actually protected. I recommend giving this a try.

As someone who is obsessed with healing their barrier and having hydrated skin -- this Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum from Anua is smooth, watery, and silky! It's a GREAT performer that leaves you with VERY dewy and glowing skin. However, it does take a moment for the serum to completely dry down, so keep that in mind! But, I love the fact that this is unscented, not tacky, and is NOT greasy in the slightest! This is my first time using any type of K-Beauty product and I REALLY do like it! But, it's nothing out of the ordinary. But, regardless, this would still be a wonderful addition into your everyday skincare routine. And, if you're someone who has always wondered about Anua? This would be the most perfect entry into the K-Beauty skincare space!

If your skin is feeling dull, irritated, dry, or rough, put this in your cart! I was pleasantly surprised by this silky, gooey serum, that feels so soft on skin and dries down completely. The texture really makes skin looks plump and soft immediately, but I've noticed too that the more I use it, the better my skin gets. Perfect for all skin types, because it leaves no residue and is undetectable. I love that it has niacinamide and zinc, but also ceramides to soften. It's a must, and plays so well with your favorite moisturizer.

This winter has been brutal in terms of weather and temperature changes. My skin barrier needs support now more than ever to avoid breakouts and dryness. This serum is perfect for those needing to repair, strengthen, or maintain their skin barrier! It's a very hydrating serum that can be used by many skin types in my opinion! This Rice Ceramide Hydrating serum utilizes hylauronic acid, rice extracts, and more clean + effective ingredients to soothe, brighten, and hydrate skin! This product is fragrance free making it great for those with sensitive skin. The texture is similar to the mix soon bean essence but not as stringy or slimy! It's lightweight while still being hydrating so it's not too heavy for those with oily skin types either. Overall, this serum blew me away in terms of how healing and hydrating it is! An underrated Anua product for sure!

This product contains so many amazing ingredients. It's deeply hydrating with hyaluronic acids, and soothing with ceramides. These two ingredients alone make for a great serum for dry skin and barrier support. It also contains niacinamide, arbutin, and zinc for additional skin healing and dark spot benefits. Niacinamide also helps reduce sebum production, so you get hydration without looking or feeling greasy. The texture of this serum reminds me a lot of snail mucin. It has a thicker consistency, with similar viscosity and tackiness, but it doesn't leave your skin feeling sticky.

avis.titre: My Skin's New Best Friend: The Serum That Works Wonders
avis.texte: I can't say enough good things about this serum! It has completely transformed how my skin looks and feels. From the very first application, my skin felt softer, and more hydrated, and instantly soothed. The lightweight gel texture is so refreshing and perfect for daily use without feeling heavy. The combination of Honey Extract and seven types of Rice Extract is truly magical. Not only does it leave my skin glowing and luminous, but it also helps balance sebum production, keeping my complexion smooth and fresh all day. My moisture barrier feels stronger, and I've noticed fewer dry patches and less irritation. I noticed real improvements within just few days- my skin feels healthier, stays hydrated longer, and has a gorgeous, natural glow. This isn't just a serum; it's an essential part of my skincare routine now. If you are aiming for a radiant, balanced, and hydrated skin, I highly recommend giving it a try!

This serum is Becoming one of my absolute favorites! My skin barrier has been struggling this winter with the cold, dry air and this serum has been adding a ton of hydration to my skin. I use this every morning under my moisturizer and have been loving it in my routine. I love that this serum has no fragrance, which is something I always find to be a plus in my skincare products. Rice is one of my favorite ingredients in skincare, as it's always so soothing on the skin. I love that while this serum is so hydrating it also has Niacinamide and zinc to help control oil and sebum! As an acne prone skin girlie this is my ideal serum! I can't wait to continue using this in my routine and see how well it helps my skin barrier throughout the rest of the winter.

I have very dry skin, and my skin barrier is definitely damaged, so I was looking forward to using this serum. What I really liked about this product was that it absorbed very quickly into my skin. I really appreciated how it didn't leave my face feeling sticky like a lot of other products do. I do think this product is soothing, it calmed down the redness of my face. Even though this serum is somewhat hydrating, I still needed to use a moisturizer afterwards in order to truly heal my skin. Thus, I think something that could be improved about this product is to make it more moisturizing so that people only need to use this serum in their routine and can minimize the amount of other products they need to use. Overall, I am excited to keep using this product and see what benefits it continues to bring to my skin.

The ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum targets skin hydration, strengthens the skins barrier, and promotes a smooth and bright complexion. I have sensitive skin and this product was non-irritating. I was pleased that it did not have any fragrance because that often irritates my skin. The serum is extremely lightweight and absorbs into the skin without leaving an oily or sticky texture. This serum is a great option for anyone looking for a simple, effective, and gentle addition to their skincare routine. It layered well with the other products I use in my skincare routine and did not cause any reactions. If you are looking for a product to add to your skin care routine I encourage you to add this one. I am looking forward to seeing what this product does for my skin in the long run.

Am super excited to try this product.The ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum is a bomb and I love it, this serum is fragrance free and is blended with rice extracts and ceramides, which work together to nourish the skin and strengthen its natural barrier.this product is lightweight has a silky texture that feels good on the skin, absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. It provides an instant surge of hydration, making my skin feel plump and revitalized .It did enhance my skin's moisture retention. The ceramides help to lock in hydration, have noticed a significant improvement in my skin's overall texture and elasticity, giving it a more youthful appearance.Have added this serum to my skin care routine, using it twice a day.

avis.titre: Match made in Heaven for me!!!
avis.texte: The ANUA Rice + Ceramide Cleansing Powder is a game-changer in my skincare routine. I know this is essential regardless of my skincare routine, and while I sometimes forget, I've been making a conscious effort to ensure I don't skip this step anymore.
